findings: The checked instrument is a previously saved Bimpli, Pluxee or Up Déjeuner voucher PaymentMethod. A restaurant or store SIRET must have been provisioned for acceptance, and the saved voucher could have been saved during an existing payment. The demonstrated balance request uses server-side secret-key authentication and the PaymentMethod ID, distinct from the store’s SIRET and either of the later PaymentIntent IDs (old raw lines 12-44, new raw lines 25-56).

The `payment_method_balance` response gives benefit-keyed, currency-specific available amounts under `balance.fr_meal_voucher.available` and an `as_of` retrieval timestamp. A check can inform display, split allocation, or a pre-PaymentIntent sufficiency check. It places no hold and can become stale immediately, including through a concurrent purchase. Daily allowance and food-only restrictions still apply. Neither sample `livemode: true` nor the separate 10.00 EUR sandbox fixture establishes live funds or authorization (old raw lines 19-27,46-75, new raw lines 31-39,58-87).

Both captures keep the same split-tender prose: check, use separate PaymentIntents for voucher and secondary portions when insufficient, process secondary first or delay voucher manual capture until secondary succeeds, and handle a failed leg by reversing the other within the documented capture constraint. The November checkout diagram additionally shows restart and error paths and an apparently opposed confirmation order (old raw lines 77-85, new raw lines 89-114). contributions.original_prompts:
New raw: `raw/stripe-payments-meal-vouchers-fr-meal-vouchers-checking-a-card-balance-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw: `raw/stripe-fr-meal-vouchers-check-balance-2025.md`. Current summaries: `wiki/sources/source-stripe-fr-meal-vouchers-check-balance.md`.

- Q1: For `https://docs.stripe.com/payments/meal-vouchers/fr-meal-vouchers/checking-a-card-balance`, what central documented behavior, prerequisites, identities and state boundaries does the complete new capture establish, and how does it compare with the matched old capture and every mapped current summary?

- Q2: Which changes are substantive versus presentational or navigation-only? Which historical claims must remain dated, which conflicts need reciprocal warnings, and which API, UI, version, client/server or outcome qualifications prevent unsupported inferences?

reviewed_answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/meal-vouchers/fr-meal-vouchers/checking-a-card-balance, Stripe documents an optional pre-payment balance check for saved Bimpli, Pluxee and Up Déjeuner vouchers after restaurant or store SIRET provisioning. The voucher can have been saved during an earlier payment. Using a secret key on the server, the integration calls POST /v1/payment_methods/{id}/check_balance with the saved PaymentMethod ID. The payment_method_balance response returns amount and currency entries in balance.fr_meal_voucher.available. Its as_of timestamp records when the balance was retrieved. The check can inform checkout display and payment allocation. It places no hold, so a concurrent purchase can cause authorization to decline (old raw lines 19-66, new raw lines 31-78). Food-only restrictions and daily allowances continue. Ineligible delivery or service charges require a separate payment method even when the voucher balance could cover them. This is a distinct split-tender use from an eligible purchase exceeding the available balance (raw/stripe-payments-meal-vouchers-fr-meal-vouchers-2026-11-07.md:150-160). The 10.00 EUR sandbox fixture is separate from the illustrative live-mode response and merchant outcomes (old raw lines 68-75, new raw lines 80-87). The May and November split-tender prose supports two PaymentIntents on insufficiency and secondary-first processing or delayed capture of the voucher leg. November adds explicit checkout diagram steps that place voucher confirmation first (old raw lines 77-85, new raw lines 89-114). source-stripe-fr-meal-vouchers-check-balance.md accurately captures POST, response timing, the fixture and May's written ordering, while omitting the listed issuer scope, SIRET provisioning, save-during-payment and the two-intent/failure boundary.
reviewed_answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/meal-vouchers/fr-meal-vouchers/checking-a-card-balance, the substantive additions are a private-preview waitlist request and captured split-tender diagram text. The diagram confirms the voucher first and then the secondary PaymentIntent, with a voucher revert on secondary failure. Both captures’ written guidance says secondary first or manual voucher capture after secondary success. May includes only a diagram pointer. Preserve the November voucher-success and revert arrows as dated contradictory evidence. The diagram leaves open whether voucher success means an uncaptured authorization or capture, and gives no payment state for the revert arrow. The overview documents releasing an uncaptured voucher authorization and excludes refunds after capture. The diagram therefore cannot serve as instructions for reversing a captured voucher (raw/stripe-payments-meal-vouchers-fr-meal-vouchers-2026-11-07.md:109-113). Preserve the written guidance, no-post-capture-refund scope and optional, non-binding check as dated in source-stripe-fr-meal-vouchers-check-balance.md, and link the diagram conflict reciprocally to the concept and split-tender overview (old raw lines 8-21, old raw lines 68-85, new raw lines 9-33, new raw lines 80-114). Likewise link the dedicated guide’s unchanged POST to the separate overview source’s unsupported GET claim. Blockquote cleanup, spacing and renumbering are presentational. The checkout diagram describes merchant orchestration and supplies no atomic operation, client-side balance endpoint or proof of successful payment, reversal or settlement. The separate November payment acceptance guide requires Stripe API 2026-05-27.preview or later and an active fr_meal_vouchers_conecs_payments capability on the PaymentLocation. These are payment-acceptance requirements. The balance request supplies no version or location request field (old raw lines 37-48, new raw lines 49-60, raw/stripe-payments-meal-vouchers-fr-meal-vouchers-accept-a-payment-2026-11-07.md:24-37).
